messages:
lina-people-ops: Quick heads-up — we published the Sabbatical Pilot policy draft for salaried staff in US / UK / CA. Managers, please review eligibility + manager checklist and complete the payroll sync by EOD Fri. Training + quick quiz links below. Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/HR/pages/Sabbatical+Pilot

mike-payroll: Thanks Lina. Two quick questions: 1) Is pay continuation full/partial/unpaid? 2) Which payroll code should we use so we can map it into our export?

lina-people-ops: Good Q. Pilot terms: 50% pay continuation for sabbaticals >3 months, unpaid for under 3 months. Payroll code: SABB-P. I've updated the checklist with the mapping and an example CSV.

anya-legal: FYI for UK teams — we need explicit trial-period wording and a clause about statutory leave interaction. Also flagged IR35/checks for contractors transitioning to sabbatical-eligible roles. I've pushed a legal diff on Confluence.

kevin-eng: Manager question — does taking a sabbatical trigger hiring headcount freezes or approvals? If a senior IC is out for 3–6 months managers will want to backfill.

lina-people-ops: Hiring remains allowed but managers should note FTE impact in the hiring request form. Added a new field "Sabbatical coverage" in the hiring toolkit. Please include expected coverage plan in the req.

maya-emea-ops: Quick note: APAC not in scope for the pilot yet. Legal is still reviewing Singapore / India tax and statutory requirements. Please ensure no auto-enrollments for APAC staff.

mike-payroll: I'll add the SABB-P mapping Monday and will need a sample CSV export for verification. Sample provided below for reference:```
employee_id,period_start,period_end,pay_code,amount
12345,2026-07-01,2026-09-30,SABB-P,50%
```

lina-people-ops: Thanks Mike — sample looks good. Also tagging managers: please complete the manager checklist and the short compliance quiz by next Wed so we can firm up the first cohort. Quiz: https://forms.office.com/sabbatical-quiz

scheduling-bot: Created event "Sabbatical Pilot — Manager Briefing" on Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/7890.

mike-payroll: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with the payroll export after mapping is added.

lina-people-ops: Great — tracking doc updated with owners and due dates. I'll post a weekly digest in #people-ops until pilot launch. :eyes:
